notes.title: New Soccer Manager Released
notes.notes:
Hi All, 

We are excited to announce that we have released an updated version of Soccer Manager. Now you can access your single player and multiplayer teams all under one title. 

You can find the new version of Soccer Manager here - http://store.steampowered.com/app/438600/

Please note any saved content from Soccer Manager 2016 will follow you over to the new and improved Soccer Manager title. 

Enjoy! 
Soccer Manager Team

notes.title: New - Soccer Manager 2016
notes.notes:
Hi,

Soccer Manager 2016 is now available in steam. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/407120/

We will be stopping updating 2015 shorty and you won't be able to start new games in 2015. Anyone who wishes to carry on playing Soccer Manager please download Soccer Manager 2016, its still free and we will continue to improve the game over the coming months!

New in this version is an interactive 2D pitch (with sound), new competitions, approval ratings and much more

Thanks for your support

notes.title: Soccer Manager now with X- PLATFORM TECHNOLOGY
notes.notes:
Soccer Manager has developed unique X-PLATFORM technology that allows you to save your game to a personal Soccer Manager Cloud. With many other games on the market, users are forced to set up new accounts for different devices. We wanted to make your team accessible from anywhere.

With Soccer Manager's X-PLATFORM technology, you can literally take your game anywhere. Play on desktop (www.soccermanager.com), Facebook, Steam, mobile app, even your mates laptop and your saved game will be there. All you have to do is login to your individual account and your team will be waiting for your orders

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Start Of New Season 2015/16
notes.notes:
Play with the latest leagues and squads of 2015/2016 - the first management game with the new season update

Updated from our SoccerWiki, thanks to thousands of community members from all over the footballing world. There is nothing worse than outdated squads and to make sure you get the best Soccer Manager experience. We will be updating all leagues and squads proactively, on a regular basis.
